metadata.description: 黑曜纪元角色成长、修行体系、技能树、局内构筑、局外谱系、任务评分与RAG面板的首版机器可读数值目录。

growth.gainFormula: baseXp * relevance * challengeFit * executionQuality * recoveryState * novelty

methodProgression.practiceGainFormula: base * difficultyFit * novelty * correctness * mentorship * riskFit

functionalExperienceSoftCap.conversionFormula: if raw<=cap then raw; if cap<raw<=1.8*cap then cap+0.5*(raw-cap); if raw>1.8*cap then cap+0.4*cap+0.2*(raw-1.8*cap)

rewardClaimCaps.disclaimer: coin和aether是合同托管、敌方库存、场景储备或合法回收的可申领上限，不是击杀凭空铸造。

priceFormation.formula: max(1, floor(basePrice * scarcity * demand * urgency * condition * legality * relationship) + serviceFee)

形成第一套可重复循环并解锁反应槽
确立主分支并获得第一项局外容错
构筑身份风格，允许一个可转译辅体系入口
强化横向策略与领域能力，不扩大纯数值碾压
形成成熟流派，阶段六作为高表现冲刺而非保底
